top_signals.title: Burnham stokes Brexit debate ahead of UK-EU summit
top_signals.summary: Prime Minister calls for ‘honest discussion’ about free movement of people

top_signals.title: U.S. refineries have been running at very high rates in 2026
top_signals.summary: The U.S. refinery fleet has run at higher-than-normal rates this year, with refinery utilization averaging more than 95% of capacity between May and September, the highest for those months since 1998. Tight global product supplies this year have boosted margins for petroleum products, particularly for diesel, incentivizing the increased run rates.
